features.name: User Registration
features.description: Multi-method user registration supporting email/password, social login (Google, Facebook, Apple), and phone number with SMS verification, with progressive profiling and age verification

requirementDetails.userStory: As a new user, I want to create an account using my preferred method, so that I can access the car rental platform quickly and conveniently
acceptanceCriteria: Provide multiple registration methods: email/password, social login, phone with SMS
Require valid email and password meeting security requirements (8+ characters)
Send verification email with activation link expiring after 24 hours
Authenticate via OAuth 2.0 for social login with auto-verified email
Send SMS OTP for phone number verification
Create account with 'unverified' status for email or 'verified' for social login
Reject duplicate email/phone with appropriate error message
Reject registration for users under minimum age (18-25 by region)
Display terms of service and privacy policy for acceptance
Implement progressive profiling to collect minimum info upfront

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Comprehensive user profile management with personal information, preferences, verification status, profile photo, address autocomplete, language/currency settings, data export, and profile completeness indicator

requirementDetails.userStory: As a registered user, I want to manage my personal information and preferences, so that I can personalize my experience and ensure my details are accurate
acceptanceCriteria: Display personal information: name, email, phone, DOB, photo, address
Validate data format (email, phone, DOB) before saving
Send verification email to new address and require confirmation before updating
Send SMS verification code to new phone and require confirmation before updating
Validate profile photo file type (JPEG, PNG), size (max 5MB), dimensions, resize and optimize
Provide address autocomplete suggestions using mapping service API
Apply language and currency preferences across all platform interactions
Display profile completeness indicator showing percentage of completed fields
Generate machine-readable data export (JSON/CSV) within 30 days for GDPR compliance
Display verification status badges for verified email, phone, driver's license

features.name: Saved Preferences and Personalization
features.description: Save and manage user preferences including pickup/return locations, preferred vehicle types, default insurance, extras, payment method, accessibility requirements, and addresses with proactive booking suggestions

workflowContext.workflow: Vehicle Search Workflow, Booking Creation Workflow

requirementDetails.userStory: As a frequent renter, I want to save my preferences and frequently used information, so that I can book vehicles faster without re-entering the same details
acceptanceCriteria: Store pickup/return location with custom nickname for quick selection during booking
Prioritize preferred vehicle types in search results
Pre-select preferred insurance tier during booking when default insurance set
Pre-select default extras (GPS, child seat) during booking
Pre-select default payment method during checkout
Automatically filter search results to show only compatible vehicles when accessibility requirements saved
Display all saved items with edit/delete options when viewing saved preferences
Use saved home address for location-based search and delivery options
Offer saved work address as quick pickup/return location option
Proactively suggest similar vehicles for future bookings based on booking history patterns

features.name: Date and Time Availability Search
features.description: Specify exact pickup and return dates/times with calendar and time pickers, rental duration calculation, real-time availability checking, date validation, minimum/maximum rental period enforcement, availability calendar per vehicle, and quick date selection options

sources.section: Requirement VS-3: Date and Time Availability Search

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to specify exact pickup and return dates and times, so that I see only vehicles available for my specific rental period
acceptanceCriteria: Provide calendar picker for selecting pickup and return dates
Provide time picker with configurable intervals (15, 30, or 60 minutes)
Calculate and display rental duration when dates and times selected
Perform real-time availability checking as dates change
Validate that return date/time is after pickup date/time
Enforce minimum rental period requirements (e.g., 1 hour or 1 day)
Enforce maximum rental period requirements (e.g., 30 or 90 days)
Show availability calendar per vehicle when displaying details
Display blocked dates for maintenance or existing bookings
Enforce buffer time between bookings for vehicle preparation
Display validation error and prevent search when past dates selected
Support quick date selection options (e.g., 'This Weekend', 'Next Week')

features.name: Comprehensive Vehicle Information Display
features.description: Display detailed vehicle information including specifications, capacity, technical details, features, pricing breakdown with volume discounts, insurance options, additional services, supplier info, availability calendar, image gallery, customer reviews, environmental info, accessibility features, total cost estimate, special offers, and share option

sources.section: Requirement VS-9: Comprehensive Vehicle Information Display

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to view detailed vehicle information, so that I can make informed booking decisions without contacting support
acceptanceCriteria: Display basic specs: make, model, year, license plate
Display capacity: seats, doors, luggage space
Display technical details: engine type, transmission, fuel policy, mileage limits
List all vehicle features (air conditioning, multimedia, safety, connectivity)
Display pricing breakdown: hourly, daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly rates
Show volume discounts for longer rental periods
Display insurance options with costs (theft protection, collision damage waiver, full insurance)
List additional services and costs (additional driver, GPS, child seats, pet fees)
Display supplier/host info: name, rating, location, response time
Show availability calendar with visual representation
Provide image gallery with multiple high-quality photos (exterior, interior, features)
Display customer reviews and ratings from previous renters
Show environmental info: CO2 emissions, fuel efficiency
Display eco-friendly badge for low-emission and electric vehicles
List accessibility features (hand controls, ramps, modifications)
Show total estimated cost for selected rental period when displaying pricing
Highlight any special offers or discounts applicable to the vehicle
Provide 'Share' option to send vehicle details to others

features.name: Vehicle Reviews and Ratings System
features.description: 1-5 star rating system with detailed reviews, rating categories (cleanliness, performance, value, accuracy, host communication), photo uploads, verified reviews from completed rentals, review sorting, helpfulness voting, host responses, moderation, aggregate rating display, and rating distribution

sources.section: Requirement VS-10: Vehicle Reviews and Ratings System

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to read reviews from previous renters, so that I can make informed decisions based on authentic experiences
acceptanceCriteria: Display 1-5 star rating system with half-star precision for each vehicle
Allow customers to write detailed reviews with character limits
Provide rating categories (cleanliness, performance, value, accuracy, host communication)
Allow customers to upload photos from their rental experience
Verify that reviews come only from confirmed, completed rentals
Provide sorting options for reviews (by date, rating, helpfulness, relevance)
Allow users to upvote or downvote review helpfulness
Allow hosts or suppliers to respond to reviews
Implement automated and manual review moderation for inappropriate content
Display aggregate rating with total review count
Show rating distribution (number of 5-star, 4-star, etc. reviews)
Highlight verified bookings when displaying reviews
Filter reviews by rental duration or vehicle configuration if relevant
Display most helpful reviews prominently

features.name: Saved Searches and Alerts
features.description: Save search criteria with custom names, quick access from dashboard, price drop alerts, availability notifications, configurable notification preferences (email, push, SMS), search management and deletion, search sharing via link, search history, saved search limit, and automatic date updates

sources.section: Requirement VS-13: Saved Searches and Alerts

requirementDetails.userStory: As a frequent renter, I want to save my search criteria and receive alerts, so that I can quickly repeat searches and never miss deals on preferred vehicles
acceptanceCriteria: Allow logged-in users to save search criteria with custom names
Provide quick access to saved searches from user dashboard
Send price drop alerts for saved searches via email or push notification
Send availability notifications when vehicles matching saved criteria become available
Allow users to configure notification preferences (email, push, SMS)
Allow users to manage and delete saved searches
Allow users to share saved searches with others via link
Maintain search history for logged-in users
Limit number of saved searches per user (e.g., maximum 10)
Update dates to current or future dates automatically when executing saved search

features.name: Corporate Policy Compliance Search
features.description: Automatic corporate policy filter application, vehicle class restrictions by employee level, spending limit enforcement, approved supplier/location filtering, policy compliance indicator, exception request with approval workflow, policy filter reason display, travel manager override capability, policy exception logging, and budget/cost center display

sources.section: Requirement VS-15: Corporate Policy Compliance Search

requirementDetails.userStory: As a corporate client employee, I want to see only policy-compliant vehicles, so that I can book within company guidelines without manual verification
acceptanceCriteria: Apply corporate policy filters automatically when corporate user logs in
Restrict vehicle class selections based on employee level or role
Enforce spending limits by filtering vehicles exceeding maximum daily rate
Display only approved suppliers or locations per corporate policy
Show policy compliance indicator on each vehicle
Allow corporate users to request exception for non-compliant vehicles with approval workflow
Display reason when vehicles are filtered out due to policy
Allow corporate travel managers to override policy filters when booking for employees
Log all policy exceptions for audit purposes
Display estimated cost against corporate budget or cost center

features.name: Subscription Member Vehicle Reservation
features.description: Display only subscription tier vehicles, show subscription allowance status (remaining miles/hours/days), indicate vehicles requiring additional payment, allow tier upgrades with surcharge, show vehicle swap availability, enforce subscription booking restrictions, display subscription-specific pricing/benefits, allow immediate pickup booking, and show member priority/exclusive access

sources.section: Requirement VS-16: Subscription Member Vehicle Reservation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a subscription user, I want to search and reserve vehicles within my subscription tier, so that I can access vehicles included in my plan
acceptanceCriteria: Display only vehicles available in subscription tier when subscription user logs in
Show subscription allowance status (remaining miles, hours, or days)
Indicate which vehicles require additional payment beyond subscription
Allow subscription users to upgrade to higher-tier vehicles with surcharge
Show vehicle swap availability based on subscription plan rules
Enforce subscription booking restrictions (e.g., advance booking window, maximum rental duration)
Display subscription-specific pricing and benefits
Allow subscription users to book vehicles for immediate pickup if available
Show subscription member priority or exclusive access to certain vehicles

features.name: Mobile-Optimized Search Experience
features.description: Responsive design for mobile screens, mobile-optimized input types, touch-friendly interface with 44x44px tap targets, minimized typing with autocomplete, mobile gestures support, optimized images for mobile bandwidth, mobile-specific features (location detection, click-to-call), mobile network performance optimization, offline result caching, app deep linking, mobile-friendly filters, and mobile comparison view

requirementDetails.userStory: As a mobile user, I want a search experience optimized for my smartphone, so that I can search and book vehicles easily on the go
acceptanceCriteria: Provide responsive design adapting to mobile screen sizes
Use mobile-optimized input types (date picker, location picker)
Provide touch-friendly interface with appropriately sized tap targets (minimum 44x44 pixels)
Minimize typing requirements using autocomplete and suggestions
Support mobile gestures (swipe, pinch-to-zoom on images)
Optimize images for mobile bandwidth and screen resolution
Provide mobile-specific features (current location detection, click-to-call)
Maintain search performance on mobile networks (3G, 4G, 5G)
Support offline search result caching for previously viewed vehicles
Provide mobile app deep linking to specific search results
Optimize filter interface for mobile with collapsible sections
Provide mobile-friendly comparison view for multiple vehicles

features.name: Multi-Language and Multi-Currency Support
features.description: Multiple interface languages with user selection, browser language detection, language preference persistence, translate all interface elements, multiple currency support, currency detection from location/browser, manual currency selection, display prices in selected currency with exchange rates, currency conversion disclaimer with update timestamp, translate vehicle descriptions, localized date/time formats, and RTL language support

sources.section: Requirement VS-20: Multi-Language and Multi-Currency Support

requirementDetails.userStory: As an international customer, I want to search in my preferred language and currency, so that I can understand pricing and information clearly
acceptanceCriteria: Support multiple interface languages with user selection option
Detect user's preferred language from browser settings
Maintain language preference across sessions for logged-in users
Translate all search interface elements, labels, and messages
Support multiple currencies for price display
Detect user's currency preference from location or browser settings
Allow users to manually select preferred currency
Display prices in selected currency with current exchange rates
Show currency conversion disclaimer with last update timestamp
Translate vehicle descriptions and features when available
Provide localized date and time formats based on user's region
Support right-to-left (RTL) languages where applicable

features.name: Notification Fatigue Prevention
features.description: Limit notification frequency per user (max 5 per day excluding critical), consolidate related notifications, respect user-defined quiet hours, provide daily/weekly digest options, use appropriate urgency levels, test notification timing for optimal engagement, monitor unsubscribe rates, adjust frequency based on engagement, prioritize critical over promotional, and provide 'Pause notifications' option

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want to receive only relevant notifications at appropriate frequency, so that I'm not overwhelmed with messages
acceptanceCriteria: Limit notification frequency per user (max 5 per day excluding critical)
Consolidate related notifications into single message when possible
Respect user-defined quiet hours
Provide daily or weekly digest options for non-urgent notifications
Use appropriate urgency levels for each notification type
Test notification timing for optimal engagement
Monitor unsubscribe rates as indicator of notification fatigue
Adjust notification frequency based on user engagement
Prioritize critical notifications over promotional
Provide 'Pause notifications' option for temporary opt-out
